description:
Epoch Community Web opens into a community with its own channels (Discord-like),
  with Network Feed discovery and linked repository projects as secondary planes.

elements.name: Contributor splits a change graph atomically and reconstructs the exact snapshot

steps.name: a convergence workbench with changes "base,api,ui" and dependencies "api>base,ui>api"
I split "api" into "api-schema,api-runtime" at unambiguous file boundaries
the change graph contains both atomic changes in dependency order
reconstructing the change graph produces the original snapshot digest

elements.name: Contributor gets a safe failure when an atomic split is ambiguous

steps.name: a convergence workbench with an inseparable edit in "shared.ts"
I try to split the edit into "schema,runtime"
the split is rejected without changing the change graph
the workbench explains the ambiguous hunk that needs a human boundary

elements.name: Maintainer follows stable revisions across multiple heads and supersession

steps.name: a change with two concurrent revision heads
I open its revision history
both heads retain stable revision identities
the superseded revision remains visible without becoming current

elements.name: Maintainer reviews a bundle without losing individual change context

steps.name: a review bundle for a three-change graph
I traverse cumulative and per-change review by keyboard
the selected change remains synchronized with the review detail
the gate matrix distinguishes current passing stale and missing evidence

elements.name: Maintainer partially merges only a dependency-closed subset

steps.name: a change graph where "ui" depends on "api" and "api" depends on "base"
I request a partial merge through "api"
the merge preview includes "base,api" and excludes "ui"
the merge control explains dependency closure before confirmation

elements.name: Maintainer squashes a change graph without erasing provenance

steps.name: a dependency-closed merge preview for "base,api"
I confirm a squash with maintainer authority
the squash records both source changes and their revisions
the resulting change has a new stable identity

elements.name: Maintainer cannot merge with stale review evidence

steps.name: an approved review for an older revision
a new revision supersedes the approved revision
merge remains blocked with an unmistakable stale approval explanation

elements.name: Contributor resolves a durable conflict after deterministic help precedes AI

steps.name: a durable unresolved conflict with base left and right identities
deterministic resolution cannot resolve it
the conflict remains first-class and actionable
an AI resolution proposal arrives and I later confirm a human resolution
the AI proposal remains untrusted and the human resolution closes the conflict

elements.name: Contributor hydrates a partial browser replica and sees truthful copy isolation

steps.name: an offline browser replica with promised objects and a copy-on-write workspace
I reconnect and hydrate the selected object
availability changes without changing integrity
the workspace reports copy-on-write storage separately from execution isolation

elements.name: Contributor keeps stable mappings while escaping through interoperable forges

steps.name: a change mapped to jj and a continuous mirror with an F3 escape archive
the mirror synchronizes the latest revision
the jj change identity remains stable across revisions
the forge fidelity report names preserved and lossy fields without exporting private content

elements.name: Maintainer sponsors a finite-budget agent and later revokes it

steps.name: an agent principal with its own key sponsored by a maintainer grant
the agent reserves and consumes part of its finite budget
allocated reserved consumed released and expired amounts are distinguishable
the sponsor revokes the grant
new agent work is denied with the principal sponsor grant and budget reason

elements.name: Responder archives a public release but denies a private archive request

steps.name: a public release with an SWHID and a private raw session
I confirm the public archive request with release authority
archive status is remote-confirmed for the public release
the private archive request is denied without exposing the raw session

elements.name: Screen-reader maintainer traverses the change graph at mobile width and 200 percent zoom

steps.name: an accessible convergence workbench for a branching change graph
I navigate the change graph and review list entirely by keyboard
tree and list focus identify the same selected change and revision
at 200 percent zoom the workbench has no horizontal page overflow

elements.name: Contributor enters the Nightboard community from the Epoch landing

steps.name: Epoch Community is available
I open Epoch Community
the landing presents the creator story with CanvasUI motion
I enter the community board
the tmux-style Nightboard is ready for keyboard collaboration

steps.name: Epoch Community is available

I enter the community board
I open the Nightboard general channel from the prompt
I move to the next Nightboard message and open its thread by keyboard
the selected Nightboard message remains the single focused feed item

elements.name: Maintainer defines one action for prompt agent and voice control

steps.name: Epoch Community is available
I open Epoch Community
I enter the community board
I define the Nightboard review macro with voice phrase "start review"
the review macro persists as the "user_review" agent skill
the exact voice phrase runs the same review macro
a near voice phrase does not run it

elements.name: Agent operator consumes compatible startup conditions with one restart

the bottom line recommends one Ctrl+U restart action

the session is continued on the updated workspace defaults

steps.name: Epoch Community is available

I enter the community board

elements.name: App builder uses deterministic HoBo authoring and focused-panel controls

steps.name: Epoch Community is available

I enter the community board
I open the default Bo agent
Bo offers deterministic HoBo new build test debug and up actions
complex unsupported logic is emitted as a trainable stub
I expand and restore the focused panel by keyboard
focus and selection remain in the same panel context

steps.name: Epoch Community is available

steps.name: Epoch Community is available

elements.name: Power user chooses global jump without weakening deterministic cd

steps.name: Epoch Community is available
I open Epoch Community
I enter the community board
I compare ambiguous cd with the Nightboard global jump chooser
cd stays put while jump candidates await explicit acceptance with reasons
